data.title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
data.installation: White glove delivery and deployment services including asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations
data.product: Student Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, desktops, and monitors
data.bid_summary: Dallas ISD seeks student and staff computing devices with delivery, deployment, warranty, and asset-management requirements.
data.product_specification: Windows devices require Autopilot; Chromebooks require enrollment in Google Management. Laptop etching is required.
